source_identity.canonical_title: Dénoncer la cancel culture revient la plupart du temps à faire l'apologie de l'impunité

translation.canonical_title: Denouncing cancel culture amounts, in the greater part of cases, to advocating impunity
translation.displayed_title: Denouncing cancel culture amounts, in the greater part of cases, to advocating impunity
translation.summary: When one sees what most people regard as “cancel culture,” it becomes clear that it is actually merely fear of no longer being able to abuse their dominant position with impunity, so they are thereby regarded as victims in their own eyes.

source_parameters.name: citation
source_parameters.value: Plutôt que des effets de la cancel culture, ne faudrait-il pas s’inquiéter de la culture de l’impunité, laquelle préfère la disqualification à la dispute argumentée ? Que les choses commencent à changer, nous ne pouvons que nous en réjouir et non redouter la ''« dictature des minorités »''. C’est, au contraire, des droits de ces dernières que nous devrions nous soucier si nous voulons combattre la dérive droitière à laquelle les organisateurs, en invitant Mathieu Bock-Côté à s’exprimer, sont coupablement inattentifs.

source_parameters.name: article
source_parameters.value: Université : « L’universalisme républicain ne se décrète pas, il se construit »

citations.translated_citation: Rather than the effects of cancel culture, should we not be concerned about a culture of impunity that favors disqualification over reasoned debate? We can only welcome, rather than fear, the fact that things are beginning to change and the supposed ''“dictatorship of minorities.”'' On the contrary, we should be concerned about their rights if we want to combat the rightward drift to which the organizers, by inviting Mathieu Bock-Côté to speak, are culpably inattentive.
